name: img2threejs
tagline: Turn a reference image into a code-only procedural Three.js model
description: Rebuilds a subject from a single reference image as a fully procedural Three.js scene — no photogrammetry, no mesh extraction, just code. The pipeline is staged into blockout, structural, form, material, surface, lighting, interaction, and optimization phases, each quality-gated so output stays animation-ready and token-efficient. Includes CS2 weapon review gates, a character and creature generator, and a roadmap to v2.0 procedural world generation.
highlights: 9.6k stars and #1 trending Python repo of the week
Staged sculpting pipeline with per-phase quality gates
Animation-ready, token-efficient output designed for AI agents
Character & creature generator plus CS2 weapon review gates
Live demo gallery and v2.0 procedural world generation roadmap
curatorNote: A standout example of code-only 3D reconstruction — worth watching as it pushes toward fully procedural world generation.
